container.read_only: silently has no effect on apple-container (read-only rootfs — apple-container's rootfs is always RW, so `read_only: true` cannot be enforced). See issue #120 for the parity plan.
inspectors[1] 'not-a-real-inspector': not a known built-in inspector — the in-cage addon will skip this entry. Valid names: body-size, content-type, domain, entropy, secrets.
inspectors[2] 'custom': custom Python file inspectors (path: ...) are not yet staged into the apple-container wrapper image — the in-cage addon will skip this entry. Use a built-in inspector or stay on the container backend.
